q1_landing_at_built.answer: NO, with one repair owed inside the concern.

q1_landing_at_built.regression_against_main: None found. origin/main is an ancestor of 0b8b000; verify.py exits 0 twice over 57 checks and lint.py exits 0; the delta touches five files, all of them this member's, and the only non-record changes strengthen a fixture and add one unit test. The branch's other changes against main - two entries in contracts/verification-budget.json, two rows in scripts/README.md, two Check entries in scripts/sovverify/commissioning.py - add ceilings and checks rather than removing any, and the budget entries produce attributed debt rather than a pass.

The self-check reads the artifact it grades: it builds the fixture basis and runs the real reader over it, and the live half runs the real reader over this repository's own contracts. It grades no declaration standing in for a measurement, and it deliberately does not pin the live verdict, which is why satisfying P15-Q4.3 will not turn the suite red.
